loading.comment: I want a option 2, but with the progress bars of option 5
loading.reply: Six options, all option 2's motion on the three bars of option 5 (Sync 72 %, Backup 48 %, Upload 88 %, with their mono captions): the page tube with the ramp flowing through it, 1800 ms, the floor driving toward you, 900 ms, and the bars under them. They differ only in what was still open: 1 the straight combination (the bars exactly as they were); 2 the ramp flows through each bar's head as a short tail; 3 each bar stands on a floor of its own that drives toward you; 4 everything on one beat clock (3600 ms), the bar heads stepping one notch per beat so each lands on a beat; 5 the bars busy (no share) with the package's road; 6 the ramp in the heads alternating, bar 2 against bars 1 and 3. Corners (the light runs down the sides from the stripe's colours and fades) and the leave (the sun sets through it, the part sinking with it) are locked and no longer asked. One correction to the last round's text: I measured the direction of the ramp. In the old option 2 the ramp travels from the tube's left end to its right (the old text said the reverse); it is kept exactly as you saw it, and the texts now say what you see.
